dog.description_text:
Zayne is the sweetest companion and is happiest just being by your side! He loves lounging on the couch with you, looking out the window, and curling up for plenty of cuddles. He’s incredibly affectionate and will happily cover your face in kisses. His signature move is giving hugs: he’ll put his paws on your shoulders while you pet him and happily stay there as long as you’ll let him.

Ask Zayne if he wants to go for a walk and he’ll literally jump in the air with excitement! Despite all that enthusiasm, he’s an amazing walking buddy. He’s easy to manage on leash and doesn’t pull. He can get agitated when he sees bigger dogs, so we give them some extra space on walks, but smaller dogs don’t seem to bother him.

At home, Zayne is an easygoing houseguest. He’s fully housetrained and crate trained, and he doesn’t chew things or get into anything when he’s outside of his crate. He’s just as happy curling up with you at home as he is heading out for a walk, and mostly just wants to be wherever you are. Zayne is such a sweet, cuddly dog with so much love to give, and whoever ends up with his hugs every day will be very lucky.

﻿Zayne is approximately 9y 2m 29d old and is fully grown at 46 pounds. They are microchipped and up to date on all age-appropriate medical care. Their breed is unknown as we have not had a DNA test done.

Although our dogs are listed as unknown breed, buildings with specific dog restrictions typically enforce their rules based on what breeds a dog appears to resemble. It's always important to keep that in mind and know your building's policies before adopting a dog.

This dog is available for adoption through Muddy Paws Rescue. If you're interested in adopting, the first thing you should do is begin the registration process at www.muddypawsrescue.org. If you are already a registered adopter with Muddy Paws Rescue, please email us at adoptionmeetings@muddypawsrescue.org.
